title: llamafactory: torch-load-any @ v1/plugins/.../fsdp2.py:517

root_cause.note: FSDP2 plugin loads full-checkpoint state with torch.load(ckpt_file, map_location='cpu') and no weights_only pin. On torch>=2.6 the weights_only default is True, so the unpickling surface is closed on current stacks; on torch<2.6 the same line is a checkpoint-dir pickle RCE. Recorded as a version-paired trust boundary, not a dynamically reproduced sink on this host (torch 2.14.1/2.5.1 split).
